attendance.note: Organiser history page: close to 400 vans ('prop de 400 furgonetes') at Les Planes d'Hostoles, up from about 300 at Roda de Ter. Number of people not published.

ticket_price.note: 2026 registration per vehicle: EUR 75 (13 May to 5 Jun), EUR 85 (6 Jun to 5 Jul), EUR 95 (6 to 10 Jul, no gift T-shirt). Places limited.

add_sources.note: 'Furgofesta és un festival sense ànim de lucre'. Site footer 'ORGANITZA' shows the FurgoFesta logo only; no legal entity named.
History: started 2006 in les Masies de Roda with about 20 vans; about 300 at Roda de Ter; now close to 400 vans at Les Planes d'Hostoles.
Registration tiers per vehicle for 2026 as quoted.
Contact page: 'Tens una proposta? Vols ser patrocinador?' and info@furgofesta.cat.
18 Jun 2026: 'nostres patrocinadors principals': Bluetti, Rock&Wagen, Homologa Tu Furgo.
22 Jul 2026: 'Patrocinadors oficials' Bluetti, Rock&Wagen, Homologa Tu Furgo, Kiwi Estudi, Cervesa Montseny.
28 Jul 2026 thanks to supporting businesses Camper Attitude, La Troka Camper, La Pinza, Lulukabaraka, Furgoinstall, and Càmping Alguer, 'la casa que any rere any ens obre les portes'.
Bluetti x Furgofesta giveaway of a Bluetti Elite 10 power station after the event.
